assertions.statement: Owner-authorized historical correction changes only the selected own account purchase date/stage history plus update metadata; current status, renewal configuration/watermarks, balances, other account fields and all ledger rows remain unchanged, with no fee/progression operation or inferred date.

The funnel inspection drawer defaults to detected pending issues and offers searchable all-account access for the owner, including accounts with no detected issue; switching tabs/searching does not mutate any account or ledger data.

Per-account diagnostics distinguish missing facts from suspected mistakes without inventing dates, sorting or deduplicating legitimate attempts; instant-funded exceptions and full-history scope remain clear.

One-account drafts support separate purchase/history edits, additions/removal/restoration, actual before/after confirmation and removal acknowledgement; unsaved navigation never silently saves or discards.
Owner/version/missing-row/permission/error and busy/double-submit paths preserve saved data and draft safety with no silent overwrite or full-row write.
Removing or editing a first historical event never interprets array position as purchase identity or shifts purchase/activation cash rows; legacy integration is regression-tested.
Confirmed history updates existing funnel/cohort/pass/company statistics with truthful remaining issues while current status, cash totals and range/company/group context remain unchanged.

The revised isolated flow uses a compact header count entry without a full-width notice, horizontal rounded date/status history, public company logos/fallback, zh/en, seven palettes, light/dark, contained phone scrolling and keyboard/touch access; draft/data safety and explicit state coverage remain unchanged.
